coverage_claim: WM-KNW-016 covers a governed Assumption as a versioned premise accepted for a declared purpose and context, with identity, proposition role, epistemic status, actors, authority, scope, rationale, evidence, uncertainty, dependencies, consequences, validation, lifecycle, governance and loss-aware interoperability. Domain, legal, safety, analytical-method and independent-review questions remain deferred.

boundary_decision.rationale: The root is a persistent governed premise record with stable identity, acceptance state, reliance context and revision lineage. Challenges, validations and dependent decisions occur around it but do not turn the assumption itself into an event.

decisions.rationale: The model owns one attributable premise role and its immutable revisions rather than proposition truth, evidence content or dependent decision execution.
SACM supports viewing an assumption as a claim declaration, but analytical registers give the premise role separate governance; canonical inheritance requires joint boundary review.
Accepted, supported, validated, confirmed and true are not interchangeable; every status remains source, purpose, scope and time qualified.
The external claim or proposition retains its identity while the assumption record owns how that proposition is used as a premise in one context.
These values use different scales, methods and interpretations and require explicit basis, unit, profile, time and source.

decisions.concept: Downstream reliance and consequences if false
decisions.rationale: The assumption must expose dependent requirements, models, estimates, plans and decisions plus impacts and contingencies without importing their lifecycles.
Challenges and validation results are appended with methods and evidence; invalidation, expiry and supersession preserve prior reliance history.
Agents may append low-risk links, classifications and freshness checks but not accept risk, sign off protected assumptions or destroy records without authority.

decisions.concept: Provider waiver and local no-tools audit
decisions.rationale: One bounded Claude Sonnet attempt timed out and one bounded Grok attempt returned provider error 402. Codex separately audits the frozen validated result and comparison without acquiring new facts, so assurance remains reviewable-draft.

publication_holds: Absence-of-external-review hold: one Claude Sonnet attempt timed out and one Grok attempt returned provider error 402 before producing an admissible result; no external result was admitted.
Relation hold: WM-KNW-007 remains a required proposition reference rather than an approved parent until joint boundary review.
Boundary hold: propositions, facts, evidence, hypotheses, requirements, rules, risks, issues, decisions, plans, tests, measurements and source documents remain external masters.
Semantic hold: accepted, supported, validated, confirmed and true remain distinct source-qualified statuses.
Measurement hold: confidence, probability, uncertainty, reliability, sensitivity, materiality and risk require separate methods, scales and profiles.
Authority hold: assumption acceptance, risk acceptance, protected disclosure and irreversible deletion require accountable delegated authority.
Profile hold: engineering, analytical, AI, safety, legal and operational assumptions require domain and jurisdiction profiles.
Interoperability hold: every standards projection requires exact release pins, conformance tests and semantic-loss declarations.
Completeness hold: the 24-source draft is broad but does not claim universal epistemic, domain, legal, safety or operational coverage.
deferred_research: Reconcile the WM-KNW-007 registry parent signal with the separate identity needed for an assumption role in engineering and analytical logs.
Develop domain-specific assumption kinds, uncertainty methods, validation criteria, risk links, review cadences and authority profiles.
Pin every production crosswalk to exact licensed or open releases and run bidirectional conformance and semantic-loss tests.
Obtain independent epistemology, systems engineering, risk, safety, legal, records, privacy and security review.
